one_liner: Fathom (fathom.video AI notetaker) has a public REST API at api.fathom.ai/external/v1. Self-serve user-scoped API keys work on all plans including free. OAuth 2.0 is available for multi-user apps, there are HMAC-signed webhooks, and there is an MCP server that is probably official.
auth_notes: API keys are generated in User Settings → API Access and sent in the X-Api-Key header. They are per user, with no org-level keys. OAuth 2.0 (Bearer token) is for apps that other Fathom users install. OAuth apps need to be registered with Fathom. OAuth apps cannot use include_summary/include_transcript on /meetings. Refresh tokens are one-time-use and rotate.
access_notes: The FAQ says API access (keys and webhooks) is included on all plans, and the ZoomInfo review says this includes the free plan. The Fathom Help Center article says anyone can browse the docs and start building. The usefathom.com changelog on paid API plans concerns Fathom Analytics, a different product, and was ignored. Rate limit is 60 calls per minute per user and Fathom does not offer higher limits.
blocker_notes: No real blocker. Minor friction: OAuth apps need registration with Fathom, and the rate limit is low at 60 calls per minute.
